user.title: Find Overscan on your TV
user.description: Enter the TV's IP address. Overscan shows it under Help & details → Home automation. Home Assistant connects to port {port}.

data_description.host: For example 192.168.1.20. Give the TV a fixed address in your router so it doesn't change.

pair.title: Pair with the TV
pair.description: On the TV at {host}, open Overscan → Help & details → Home automation and keep the page open. Enter the six-character code it shows.

data_description.code: Letters and digits; case doesn't matter. The code works only while the page is open.
data_description.name: How the TV lists Home Assistant. Each paired device needs a different name.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair with the TV again
reauth_confirm.description: The TV at {host} no longer accepts Home Assistant's key, for example after Forget devices. Open Overscan → Help & details → Home automation and enter the code it shows.

data_description.code: Letters and digits; case doesn't matter. The code works only while the page is open.
data_description.name: How the TV lists Home Assistant. Each paired device needs a different name.

reconfigure.title: Change the TV's address
reconfigure.description: Enter the TV's new IP address. Overscan shows it under Help & details → Home automation. The pairing is kept.

error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Overscan at this address. Check the address, that the TV is on the same network, and that Overscan 1.2.4 or later has been opened once since it was installed.
error.not_overscan: Something answered at this address, but it isn't Overscan.
error.invalid_code: Wrong or expired code. Keep Help & details → Home automation open on the TV and enter the code it shows now.
error.invalid_name: Use 1 to 64 plain letters, digits, spaces or symbols, without ", \ or :.
error.name_taken: The TV already has a device with this name. Choose another name, or use Forget devices on the TV first.
error.pairing_unsupported: This version of Overscan can't pair. Update Overscan on the TV.
error.register_failed: The TV couldn't save the pairing. Try again.

auth_failed.message: The TV no longer accepts Home Assistant's key. Pair again from the notification in Settings → Devices & services.

screen_off.message: The TV's screen is off, so it won't start sync. Turn the screen on first.

refused.message: The TV can't change sync now: {reason}

unsupported.message: This version of Overscan can't be controlled from Home Assistant. Update Overscan on the TV.
